Get all CI/CD flows from Open-C3 platform. Returns the complete list of flows in the system.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—retrieve a complete list of CI/CD flows from the Open-C3 platform.

- Lists all flows via the Open-C3 API `/api/ci/group/ci/dump`
- Authentication via configurable app name and key headers
- Output includes total flow count, formatted table, and group statistics
- Usage examples and configuration details provided in SKILL.md
- Requires `curl` and `jq` dependencies
